interpretation.name: WeldThenTightenMountingBracket
interpretation.goal: Weld the mounting bracket at station st1 on line 1, then tighten its fasteners with the shared nutrunner NR7 using the F25 tightening program.
constraints: Welding of the mounting bracket must be completed before any tightening starts.
The tightening program must be obtained from get-program for variant F25; no torque or tolerance literals in the Recipe (E4).
NR7 must be reserved before use and released afterwards (E1, E6).
NR7 must be transported from the crib to st1 before configure-tool or tighten-fasteners (E3, E7).
transport-tool must be executed by agvexecutor (E2).
The tightening must be evaluated against its program and recorded for traceability (E5).
Every tool-using Step renews the lease with the reservation token and depends on reserve-tool (E6).

findings.message: requested capabilities not exposed by the Local Cloud: ['weld mounting bracket']
